title: W112 Product and Phase Task Register
source_of_truth: This file is the sole source for W112 Product Task and Phase Task state. Agent Task detail is held only in DOC-004.
governing_standard: W70 DOC-056 §11; W70 DOC-094 model; W112 DOC-001 design baseline

product_tasks.product_name: ROOM-HOP Cross-Work Integration Contracts and Evidence Orchestration
product_tasks.objective: Define, verify and coordinate non-duplicative contracts across existing ROOM-HOP Works so task, identity, event, dependency, artifact and verification evidence can be correlated safely.
product_tasks.scope: Cross-Work contract design, ownership/source pinning, stable-ID correlation, dependency semantics, event/evidence provenance, idempotency/concurrency/recovery requirements and integrated verification planning.
product_tasks.status_basis: No phase is marked complete or active solely from document presence. Current phase pointer is inherited from Manifest and remains subject to W70 entry/gate rules.

phase_tasks.task_title: Inventory Works, ownership and source lineage
phase_tasks.deliverable: Owner/source inventory with evidence-backed repo, branch, path and revision pins or explicit blockers
acceptance_criteria: Read each target Work's controlling manifest, decision records and journal before inspection
Record ownership proof and source revision for every accepted mapping
Unknown ownership or path remains BLOCKED/NOT_SYNCED
phase_tasks.next_action: Finish bounded owner/source inventory without repeating completed searches unless a new source lead appears

phase_tasks.deliverable: Approved requirements, ownership boundaries, interface inventory and contract acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate W70 lifecycle, W32 CI, W33 evidence, W52 communication or component runtime ownership
Each contract field has producer, consumer, authority and failure semantics
Open questions remain explicit
phase_tasks.next_action: Prepare requirements baseline for independent architecture review

phase_tasks.task_title: Design integration contracts and trust boundaries
phase_tasks.deliverable: Reviewed schemas, sequence/interaction diagrams, error/retry model and ADRs
acceptance_criteria: Identity, assignment, event, evidence and dependency contracts are versioned
Idempotency, concurrency, timeout and recovery semantics are explicit
Independent architecture review and Vinh approval are recorded before enforcement
phase_tasks.next_action: Obtain independent review of DOC-001 and resolve open architecture decisions

phase_tasks.task_title: Plan owner adapters, dependencies and integration verification
phase_tasks.deliverable: Dependency graph, owner-specific handoffs, test strategy and gated implementation plan
acceptance_criteria: Every task has one accountable owner and distinct checker
Every dependency is tied to an owner record and source revision
No component write is planned without Work Entry and owner permission
phase_tasks.next_action: Convert approved design into owner-scoped plans and gate prerequisites

phase_tasks.task_title: Build contract schemas and owner adapters after authorization
phase_tasks.deliverable: Versioned schema fixtures and owner-approved adapters in canonical component repositories
acceptance_criteria: DOC-001 approved and owner-specific Work Entry/permission exists
Canonical repo/branch/path/base SHA pinned
Changes remain with component owners; W112 does not implement duplicate runtimes
phase_tasks.next_action: Remain design-only until review, approval, source pins and implementation permissions are present

phase_tasks.task_title: Verify contract compatibility and cross-Work flows
phase_tasks.deliverable: Reproducible contract, negative, replay, concurrency and end-to-end verification evidence
acceptance_criteria: Tests record exact source SHA, command, environment, raw result and evidence
MOCK/SNAPSHOT/SANDBOX/LIVE are distinguished
Independent QE is separate from implementation
phase_tasks.next_action: Prepare test matrix only; execution waits for executable owner-approved integration paths

phase_tasks.deliverable: Acceptance dossier with owner approvals, independent QE and traceable evidence
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory criteria pass with reproducible evidence
No unresolved critical ownership/security/recovery blocker
Final authority approval recorded
phase_tasks.next_action: Do not request acceptance before independent QE and owner sign-offs

phase_tasks.deliverable: Versioned release record, compatibility matrix and rollback plan
acceptance_criteria: Accepted version and consumers are pinned
Migration/deprecation and rollback are documented
No breaking change is silently deployed
phase_tasks.next_action: Release remains NOT AUTHORIZED until acceptance and authority approval

phase_tasks.task_title: Operate compatibility and integration evidence governance
phase_tasks.deliverable: Compatibility monitoring, drift review, incident and contract change records
acceptance_criteria: Contract drift and consumer status are traceable
Incidents include impact, root cause and corrective actions
No dashboard projection overrides owner state
phase_tasks.next_action: Define operations cadence after release authorization

progress_policy.reason: No approved weighting model and no verified phase completion or Agent ACK; do not average proposed Agent Task percentages.
prohibited_methods: Treating document presence or write acknowledgment as PASS
Promoting MOCK/SNAPSHOT/SANDBOX PASS to LIVE PASS
